gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai has puffy, rounded lowercase like inflated glass beads, with every bowl left open. Galaxy is the louder one, a dense line of unshaded strokes with loose spacing, and the body font simply keeps the text approachable.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Galaxy draws every letter with one uninterrupted line width, tall and dense and spaced out like a cosmic signboard. And Noto Sans Tifinagh, with its rounded, inviting bowls, can go a notch larger than you'd expect without feeling heavy.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Cosmic and commanding, Galaxy holds its stylus at fixed pressure, so every curve keeps the same line. Noto Sans Tirhuta is the plain sans answer, with terminals cut back to leave big gaps and a dominant x-height that would crowd if the heading shrank.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Galaxy's curves never thin out at the turns, giving a dense, tall lowercase band with loose, spacious fit. Then Noto Sans Ugaritic steps in as a plain sans with open mouths and little gap between x-height and caps, grounding the display lettering.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-vai: Noto Sans Vai sets words as solid blocks rather than jagged skylines, with generous space between curve ends and stems. And above it, Galaxy runs a thread of ink with no swelling or tapering, which makes its commanding tone the pair's boldest quality.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Noto Sans Vithkuqi reads clean and modern, its a, c, e and s keeping open throats and the capitals stepping only slightly above lowercase. But Galaxy is the one with presence, no hairlines and no swells anywhere, while the sans-serif body just keeps the lines moving.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Galaxy looks cut out with a fixed-width router bit, cosmic and commanding, with loose spacing around its dense, tall lowercase. And Noto Sans Wancho, a hulking sans-serif like thick chalk pressed hard, would carry a longer passage with a sturdy, open-gapped e.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-warang-ci: Noto Sans Warang Citi shapes words into solid blocks, with wide channels leading into each counter. And Galaxy sits over it with no thick-thin shift at all, its stroke width uninterrupted, so one font announces and the other settles in.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-yi: Noto Sans Yi reads modern and businesslike, with a deep midsection in its lowercase and rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook. And under Galaxy's lockstep curves and stems, a longer passage would flow in a sans-serif that stays easy on the eye.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square reads approachable and crisp, its soaring x-height and wide gaps holding up even at tiny sizes. And Galaxy supplies the drama above it, a display face where even the t shares one width across crossbar and stem.
